name: KiCad Track Gloss
description: Shorten or simplify explicitly selected PCB track chains.
description_full: KiCad Track Gloss is a silent one-click ActionPlugin that replaces safe selected-track staircases with shorter or simpler 0/45/90-degree chains directly on the current board. It reads KiCad board constraints and effective netclasses, generates deterministic global and batch candidates, applies the highest-saving plan, and returns immediately. Unselected copper remains immutable and KiCad Undo can revert the action.
